definitions.gloss: receiver; receiving device (for radio, television, or other signals)
definitions.explanation: An electronic device that receives and decodes transmitted signals — radio, television, telemetry, satellite, GPS, or other wireless communication. A technical but widely understood word, common in user manuals, news about broadcasting, and explanations of wireless technology.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受信機|じゅしんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{受信機|じゅしんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{受信|じゅしん}できる→受信する：26781_jushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: This receiver can pick up overseas broadcasts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらえる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{高性能|こうせいのう}→高性能：16282_kouseinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受信機|じゅしんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To accurately capture signals from satellites, a high-performance receiver is needed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧ (receiving a signal) and the suffix {〜機|き} (machine, device). The word is paired symmetrically with ⟦{送信機|そうしんき}→送信機：29461_soushinki⟧ (transmitter). In everyday conversation about consumer electronics, Japanese speakers more often name the specific device — ⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧ (radio), ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧, GPS, and so on — and reserve {受信機|じゅしんき} for technical discussion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{無線|むせん}→無線：09226_musen⟧{受信機|じゅしんき}: wireless receiver
- GPS {受信機|じゅしんき}: GPS receiver
- ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧{受信機|じゅしんき}: satellite receiver
- ⟦{高性能|こうせいのう}→高性能：16282_kouseinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受信機|じゅしんき}: high-performance receiver
- {受信機|じゅしんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感度|かんど}→感度：17860_kando⟧: receiver sensitivity

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{送信機|そうしんき}→送信機：29461_soushinki⟧: transmitter — the paired device that sends signals
- ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧: reception (of a signal) — the action itself
- ⟦アンテナ→アンテナ：19552_antena⟧: antenna — the component that picks up signals for the receiver
- チューナー: tuner — loanword; common in home-audio and TV contexts
